description: This file defines a Java class 'MatrixStack' that manages a stack of transformation matrices, providing functionality similar to OpenGL ES's matrix stack operations such as push, pop, load, multiply, orthogonal and frustum projections, rotations, scaling, and translations.

classes.name: MatrixStack
classes.description: A class that encapsulates a stack of 4x4 transformation matrices, similar to the OpenGL ES matrix stacks, supporting push, pop, load, multiply, and transformation operations.

methods.name: glFrustumf
methods.description: Sets the matrix to a perspective projection matrix defined by frustum parameters.

methods.name: glFrustumx
methods.description: Sets the matrix to a perspective projection matrix using fixed-point parameters.

methods.name: glLoadIdentity
methods.description: Resets the current matrix to the identity matrix.

methods.name: glLoadMatrixf
methods.description: Loads a matrix from a float array or buffer into the current matrix.

methods.name: glLoadMatrixx
methods.description: Loads a matrix from fixed-point int array or buffer into the current matrix.

methods.name: glMultMatrixf
methods.description: Multiplies the current matrix by another matrix provided as an array or buffer.

methods.name: glMultMatrixx
methods.description: Multiplies the current matrix by a fixed-point matrix provided as an int array or buffer.

methods.name: glOrthof
methods.description: Sets the current matrix to an orthogonal projection matrix.

methods.name: glOrthox
methods.description: Sets the current matrix to an orthogonal projection matrix using fixed-point parameters.

methods.name: glPopMatrix
methods.description: Pops the top matrix off the stack.

methods.name: glPushMatrix
methods.description: Pushes a copy of the current matrix onto the stack.

methods.name: glRotatef
methods.description: Applies a rotation transformation to the current matrix.

methods.name: glScalef
methods.description: Scales the current matrix by specified factors.

methods.name: glScalex
methods.description: Scales the current matrix using fixed-point values.

methods.name: glTranslatef
methods.description: Applies a translation to the current matrix.

methods.name: glTranslatex
methods.description: Translates the current matrix using fixed-point values.

methods.name: getMatrix
methods.description: Copies the current top matrix into a provided array.
